query.title: License number or name
query.description: A license number (e.g. "2831 - DCFR", "121901224") or part of a business or person name. Leave empty (with no Queries) to export whole license types instead.

queries.title: Queries (batch)
queries.description: Several license numbers or names in one run. Merged with the single query; duplicates removed.

searchBy.title: Search by
searchBy.description: How to read each query. Auto: digits (optionally with a suffix like "- DC") = license number, anything else = organization name. Individual name accepts "Last", "First Last" or "Last, First".

licenseTypes.title: License types
licenseTypes.description: Export mode (no query): which license types to download in full. Lookup mode: keep only these types. Names must match the DSPS list, e.g. "Dwelling Contractor", "Dwelling Contractor Qualifier", "Electrical Contractor", "Master Electrician", "HVAC Contractor", "Master Plumber", "Manufactured Home Installer". Default export: Dwelling Contractor, Dwelling Contractor Restricted, Electrical Contractor, HVAC Contractor.

constructionOnly.title: Construction & trades only
constructionOnly.description: Lookup mode without license types: keep only Trades and Manufactured Homes credentials (drops nurses, CPAs, etc. that share a name or number).

statusFilter.title: Status
statusFilter.description: Keep only this exact status, e.g. "Active", "Expired", "Suspended". Empty = all.

cityFilter.title: City
cityFilter.description: Keep only this city (exact, case-insensitive), e.g. "Milwaukee".

zipPrefix.title: ZIP prefix
zipPrefix.description: Keep only ZIP codes starting with this, e.g. "532" for the Milwaukee area.

includeDetails.title: Include detail page data
includeDetails.description: Also fetch each record's detail page: expiration date, eligibility to practice, disciplinary orders, linked qualifiers/organizations and CE hours. One extra request per record, so runs are slower.

maxResults.title: Max results per query / license type
maxResults.description: Cap applied to each query (lookup mode) or each license type (export mode). 0 = no limit.
